```artifact
## Decision Table Test Suite for U28_misc

| Condition | Action |
|---|---|
| Chemist/Lab Id exists | Display details, allow modification or deletion |
| Chemist/Lab Id does not exist | Display error message "Chemist or Lab does not exist" |
| Open Prescription Requests exist | Display error message "Chemist or Lab has open Prescription Requests - cannot delete" |
| Symptom Code exists | Display details, allow modification or deletion |
| Symptom Code does not exist | Display error message "Symptom does not exist" |
| Patient Id generated | Display Patient Profile screen |
| Consultation/Appointment Request | Raise Consultation/Appointment Request View/Generate Prescription Reports/Print Invoice |

```
